title: feat: add provider fallbacks for official models
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds one provider fallback to 42 public text, image, video, audio, and 3D models
- Pins OpenRouter routes to one provider and keeps routing inside Pollinations
- Records provider-specific fallback costs while callers retain the requested model price
- Builds on #14317 for fallback-only routes and universal upstream 5xx handling
- Verifies every route with fresh direct-provider probes, focused tests, typechecking, and staging failover tests

gist.headline: The hive grows backup wings
gist.blurb: Forty-two official models now have a second nectar route when their usual provider is unavailable. You keep asking for the same model; the hive quietly finds another way to make it happen.
gist.summary: Added provider fallbacks for 42 public text, image, video, audio, and 3D models, with Pollinations retaining model routing and charging callers the requested model price while recording provider-specific fallback costs internally.
gist.impact: Users get more resilient generations across official models: when a primary upstream provider returns a 5xx error, Pollinations can continue the request through a verified fallback provider without changing the model they asked for.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a tiny routekeeper in a cozy garden of 42 labeled code-plants representing text, image, video, audio, and 3D models. Several pastel paths lead from a glowing retro terminal to alternate provider flower gates, showing that one request can safely take a backup route while retaining its original model label and price; the eager monitor robot can hold a small route map.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art garden routing station where Polli, a cute yellow-and-dark-brown striped bee with black antennae, oval eyes, pink rectangular blush, light-blue rounded wings, and a tiny mail carrier cap, guides glowing request-pollen from a retro terminal through two gentle paths to pastel provider flower gates; a chunky CRT monitor robot happily holds a map marked "42 MODELS" while code-plants bloom around them. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, chunky retro sprites, subtle CRT glow, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic but beautiful.
